title: Collision
text: Collision means the upset of your covered auto or its impact with another vehicle or object, including a pothole, curb, median barrier or guardrail.

title: Actual cash value
text: Actual cash value is the market value of the covered auto immediately before the loss, as recorded on the claim.

title: Collision coverage
text: If Collision Coverage is shown on the declarations, we will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible.

title: Comprehensive coverage
text: If Comprehensive Coverage is shown on the declarations, we will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible.

title: Losses treated as comprehensive
text: Loss caused by hail, windstorm, flood, fire, theft, vandalism, falling objects or contact with a bird or animal is not a collision loss and is covered only under Comprehensive Coverage.

title: Liability coverage
text: We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which an insured becomes legally responsible because of an auto accident. Liability coverage does not pay for damage to your own covered auto.

title: Medical payments
text: We will pay reasonable medical expenses for bodily injury caused by an accident, up to the medical payments limit shown on the declarations.

title: Intentional loss
text: We do not cover loss caused intentionally by or at the direction of an insured.

title: Wear and tear
text: We do not cover loss due to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown, unless the damage results from a covered theft or collision.

title: Racing
text: We do not cover loss while the covered auto is used in any organised or prearranged racing or speed contest.

title: Policy period
text: This policy applies only to accidents and losses which occur during the policy period shown on the declarations.

title: Duties after a loss
text: You must promptly notify us of how, when and where the loss happened, cooperate in the investigation, and submit proof of loss. Theft and hit-and-run losses must be reported to the police within 24 hours.

title: Total loss
text: If the cost to repair the covered auto meets or exceeds the total loss threshold of its actual cash value, we may declare a total loss and pay actual cash value minus the deductible.

title: Fraud and misrepresentation
text: We do not provide coverage for any insured who has made fraudulent statements or engaged in fraudulent conduct in connection with any accident or loss.
